description: Lucas Scott joins the Tree Hill Ravens and is forced into the orbit of his estranged half-brother Nathan, turning basketball into a contest over family, identity and the life Dan Scott denied Lucas. As Lucas grows closer to Peyton and Brooke, Haley's tutoring arrangement with Nathan becomes a relationship that changes both brothers.

s01e01.description: Half-brothers Lucas and Nathan collide over basketball when Nathan challenges Lucas to a one-on-one game with a place on the Ravens at stake.

s01e02.description: Lucas considers quitting after a disastrous varsity debut, while Nathan and Peyton drift further apart and Karen confronts old feelings about Dan.

s01e03.description: Nathan tries to use Haley against Lucas as Lucas's growing popularity unsettles him, while Peyton objects to Lucas sharing her artwork without permission.

s01e04.description: A team party exposes Lucas to the privileged life he never had, pushing him to question Karen about Dan while Nathan's family tensions deepen.

s01e05.description: The annual father-son game sharpens the contrast between Dan and Keith, while Peyton struggles with the anniversary of her mother's death.

s01e06.description: Lucas and Nathan are stranded together after Whitey throws them off the team bus, while Peyton and Haley form an unexpected alliance on the journey home.

s01e07.description: Dan and Deb's basketball party reopens family wounds as Lucas acts on his feelings for Peyton and Brooke's rumor threatens Haley's growing bond with Nathan.

s01e08.description: A college party turns dangerous for Peyton, bringing Lucas and Brooke unexpectedly closer while Haley gives Nathan a genuine first chance at romance.

s01e09.description: Crushed by pressure from Dan and conflict with Haley, Nathan turns to performance-enhancing drugs while Peyton discovers Lucas has moved on with Brooke.

s01e10.description: A cancelled practice gives Brooke and Lucas a night to escape their routines, while Dan and Nathan attempt an uneasy father-son reconciliation.

s01e11.description: Nathan quits basketball to escape Dan's pressure and tries to redefine himself, as Brooke grows increasingly uneasy about Lucas and Peyton's closeness.

s01e12.description: Peyton and Lucas travel to identify a body after her father is reported missing at sea, while a Scott family birthday dinner exposes long-buried tensions.

s01e13.description: A car crash leaves Lucas critically injured and forces Dan to publicly acknowledge him as his son, while Peyton prepares to tell Brooke about their kiss.

s01e14.description: Friends and family gather around the comatose Lucas as Karen meets Brooke, learns of Deb's divorce plans and discovers the troubling circumstances of the crash.

s01e15.description: Lucas's attempt to choose Peyton over Brooke collapses into confrontation, while Keith faces losing his garage after covering Lucas's hospital costs.

s01e16.description: Nathan is caught between Dan and Deb's custody battle, while Lucas meets a new stranger during an uneasy reset of his romantic life.

s01e17.description: The group travels to a cheerleading competition where Haley unexpectedly joins the squad, while Lucas and Nathan are forced into close quarters.

s01e18.description: A charity date auction rearranges the usual pairings for one night, creating surprising connections and giving Brooke an unexpectedly memorable evening with Mouth.

s01e19.description: Lucas and Brooke face a life-changing pregnancy scare, while Haley weighs whether she is ready to take the next step with Nathan.

s01e20.description: Haley's attempt to throw a party at Nathan's apartment spirals out of control, while Brooke arrives determined not to be excluded.

s01e21.description: Lucas learns Dan once sought custody of him as a baby, while Peyton faces a crisis when Nikki takes Jake's daughter Jenny.

s01e22.description: Dan takes over coaching and drives Lucas and Nathan toward their limits as the playoffs, Whitey's health and Nathan and Haley's future all come to a head.
